name: Mist Projector Trap
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm
description: Hidden jets expel gas that quickly freezes, causing limited damage to nearby books.
disable: DC 27 Thievery check (expert) to deactivate the trap without its control key or DC 26 Crafting check to create and apply a chemical that neutralizes the gas.

defensiveAbilities.name: Icy Mist
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The northeast bookshelf is touched

Effect Freezing mist fills a 30 foot cone originating from the room's northeast corner. Creatures in the area take 5d8 cold damage (DC 25 basic Fortitude save). Creatures who fail or critically fail the saving throw take 2d8 persistent plus cold damage for up to 3 rounds. The affected area is filled with mist that functions as obscuring mist for 3 rounds.
